name: segmented-tabs
title: SegmentedTabs
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A grey track with one raised white segment. Use as the only tab pattern in the system.

hairline.purpose: Switches between a small set of views.
hairline.antiExampleWhy: Loses the raised-segment treatment that is the system's only tab pattern.

docs: Mono uppercase labels are the default. Use `mono={false}` only when a tab holds a phrase rather than a code.
